prerequisites: It is highly recommended that the student has acquired the competencies corresponding to the subjects of previous semesters.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge for performing measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to manage the activities subject to the engineering projects described in competency CG01.

Ability to draft, sign and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering whose purpose is the construction, renovation, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants and manufacturing and automation processes.
Aptitude for oral and written communication.
Ability for autonomous work.
Attitude of motivation for quality and continuous improvement.
Ability to work in a team.
Ability to solve problems.
Ability to apply knowledge in practice.
Creativity and inventive spirit in solving scientific-technical problems.
Ability to interpret technical documentation.
Ability for critical reasoning.
Ability to make decisions.
Ability for analysis and synthesis.
Ability to adapt to new situations.
Ability for organization and planning.
To know the constructive and functional characteristics of industrial machinery, from the point of view of design, manufacturing and assembly.
To know the criteria that will guide them to evaluate the suitability of using a machine in a specific industrial environment and the most appropriate way to do so.

teaching_methods: Interactive exercises and problem solving sessions, individually or in small work groups, discussing and applying concepts, principles, and methodologies from theoretical classes.
Dynamic analysis of machines and mechanisms through computer simulation tools.
Laboratory sessions where students can apply classroom knowledge, focusing on manipulating mechanisms and machines.
Voluntary activities related to the subject, developed in industrial and business contexts, scheduled within the engineering fortnight.
Verbal exposition of subject content, followed by application activities to specific situations and acquisition of basic and procedural skills related to the subject; project-oriented learning.
Individual and autonomous study and work, oriented to the assimilation of theoretical and practical contents of the subject; students are responsible for organizing their own work effectively.
Personalized help in the training process between teacher and students, including resolving doubts on concepts and their applications.
Evaluation of knowledge acquisition through objective tests.

assessment_methods.method: Written or oral tests for competency accreditation. Oral presentation of learning outcomes.
Results of learning activities carried out during the course. Practical activity reports.
